mapper.select: WITH actor_allowed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user actor JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = actor.id JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.status = 1 AND actor.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.code = 'short-domain:disable' ) AS allowed ), target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT id FROM t_short_domain WHERE id = #{shortDomainId} ), changed AS ( UPDATE t_short_domain SET status = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, state_revision = state_revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{shortDomainId} AND (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) AND status != CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END RETURNING id, host, status, state_revision, updated_at ), appended AS ( INSERT INTO t_outbox_event (id, event_type, schema_version, stream_key, partition_key, request_id, payload) SELECT event_id, 'ShortDomainAvailabilityChanged', 1, 'SHORT_DOMAIN:' || changed.id::text, changed.id::text, #{requestId}, jsonb_build_object( 'eventId', event_id::text, 'eventType', 'ShortDomainAvailabilityChanged', 'schemaVersion', 1, 'streamKey', 'SHORT_DOMAIN:' || changed.id::text, 'revision', changed.state_revision, 'occurredAt', changed.updated_at, 'requestId', #{requestId}, 'payload', jsonb_build_object( 'shortDomainId', changed.id::text, 'host', changed.host, 'enabled', changed.status = 1 ) ) FROM changed CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT uuidv7() AS event_id) generated RETURNING id ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) THEN 0 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM appended) THEN 3 ELSE 2 END
